32
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the November 29, 2006/Agrahayana 8, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Labour and Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Closure of industries in Andhra
Pradesh
*101. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the public sector and
private sector industries closed down in
Andhra Pradesh during the last three years;
(b) whether Government have
conducted any study to assess the
genuinity of their closure;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the names of the sick industries in
the State for revival of which Government
are making efforts, giving the details of such
efforts?
Deportation of Bangladeshi nationals
from NCR
*102. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise number of
Bangladeshis detected so far during 2006
who are living illegally in Delhi and in the
surrounding areas in the National Capital
Region; and
(b) the number of Bangladeshis living
illegally in the above areas, identified so
far, during the last three years, till
31st October, 2006, and those deported?
Increase in terrorism, naxalism and
militancy in States
†*103. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the incidents of terrorism,
naxalism and militancy are still continuing
in some States; and
(b) to what extent Government have
achieved success in checking the increasing
incidents of terrorism in States, giving the
State-wise details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

33
SHG Programme for self-reliance and
income generation in rural areas
†*104. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that targets under
Self Help Groups Programme for economic
self-reliance and income generation in rural
areas are not fixed for commercial banks
and Regional Rural Banks, barring
NABARD;
(b) whether it is also a fact that in the
process of fixing the size of credit scheme,
the target of Self Help Groups is not fixed
in the P.L.P. made by NABARD; and
(c) if so, Government's view in this
regard, State-wise situation and
achievement, alongwith details thereof?
Development of Southern Naval
Command
*105. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal for development of Southern
Naval Command, Kochi; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
ARWSP in Kerala
*106. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are many Accelerated
Rural Water Supply Programmes (ARWSP)
in Kerala, undertaken with the assistance
of Central Government;
(b) if so, the details of such schemes as
on date, category-wise;
(c) the total revised estimates for the
above schemes and the total Central
assistance, as on date, category-wise;
(d) whether the competent authority of
Kerala sought higher allocations during
August, 2006, for completion of the
schemes within three years;
(e) if so, the details of action taken, if
any; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
States not following priorities fixed by
Government regarding NREGS
*107. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that only a few
States, where the National Rural
Employment Guarantee Scheme (NREGS)
is being implemented, have followed the
priorities fixed by the Central Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) the corrective measures taken by
Government to see that the priorities fixed
by the Central Government are followed
by the State Governments?
Ban on employing children below age
of 14 years
*108. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a ban has
been imposed recently on employing
children below the age of 14 years in dhabas,
restaurants, homes etc.;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

34
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the machinery established to implement the
ban;
(c) a broad estimate of the number of
children who are employed as labour and
are likely to be affected by the ban; and
(d) the details of the comprehensive
plan drawn up, if any, to rehabilitate the
children who would be rendered jobless?
Fracas by military personnel in trains
†*109. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
there has been an increase in the incidents
of military personnel coming face to face
quarrelling with common passengers in
trains;
(b) the number of such incidents which
came to the notice of Government during
the last three years;
(c) the reasons for increase

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the November 29, 2006/Agrahayana 8, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Review of FTAs
709. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) to what extent the Free Trade
Agreements with various countries have
benefited the farmers of other countries;
(b) whether there is a proposal to review
the benefits of such agreements;
(c) if so, whether all such agreements
would be reviewed, freshly assessed and
audited to find out their benefits; and
(d) the steps proposed to review all those
agreements?
NSC caution regarding foreign
investment
†710. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Security Council has advised Government
to exercise care in granting approvals to
foreign capital investments for certain areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
the council has identified the countries from
which capital investments should be obtained
carefully; and
(c) if so, which are those countries?
Fall in price of spices
711. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
downward trend in the price of spices;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have taken
measures to protect the interests of the
farmers against the price fluctuations; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Investments by Indian businessmen
abroad
†712. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
businessmen/industrialists are investing

167
abroad, instead of investing in Indian
industries;
(b) whether Indian companies are
lagging far behind in the matter of
investments in Indian projects, in
comparison to other countries;
(c) if so, whether Government are aware
of this phenomenon; and
(d) if so, what are the details thereof and
what necessary steps are being taken by
Government in this regard?
Economic partnership agreement with
Japan
713. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to enter
into an economic partnership agreement
with Japan, on the lines of the agreements
signed with Mauritius and Singapore; and
(b) if so, by when the agreement would
be finalized and its likely benefits to the
country?
FDI in Andhra Pradesh
714. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise details of Foreign
Direct Investment permitted by
Government, for industrialization in the
country, during the last three years;
(b) whether Government have
formulated any scheme to promote/permit
more Foreign Direct Investment in Andhra
Pradesh, in comparison to other States;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, what other steps are being
taken by Government to promote
industrialization in Andhra Pradesh?
FDI in India vis-a-vis China, Russia
and Brazil
715. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how does the present level of FDI in
the country compare with other countries
like China, Russia and Brazil;
(b) what are the reasons for the
difference; and
(c) what steps Government propose to
take to attract more FDI?
Export of tea, pepper and cardamom
716. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of development schemes
undertaken for increasing productivity and
for export of tea, pepper and cardamom;
(b) the quantum of processed food
products exported during the last three
years; and
(c) whether it is a fact that inroads of
processed food product in domestic market
have posed threat to Indian companies?
Import of agricultural products
717. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of major agricultural
products imported during the last three
years, with quantity;
(b) the reasons for their import;
(c) whether such imports affected the
local farmers/traders; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

168
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Promotion of industries in
Uttrakhand
718. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what steps have been taken by
Government to promote industries in
Uttrakhand;
(b) what have been the results of these
steps during the last two years and the
current year, so far; and
(c) what financial provisions have been
made by Government in this regard during
the same period?
Industries in industrially backward
districts of AP
